::: {.flex-1 .z-1 .justify-self-start .max-w-full .break-words .text-start .self-start .justify-start .leading-snug}
Route Access Configuration
:::

In Jumbo, route access is managed by specifying paths in two arrays:
`publicPaths`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center .items-center
.ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm .text-[.875em]
.leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]} and `anonymousPaths`{.py-px
.px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset
.ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm .text-[.875em]
.leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}, which are defined in the file
`/src/config/routes/path.ts`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center
.items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm
.text-[.875em] .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}. This setup helps
in controlling access to different parts of the application based on the
user\'s authentication status.

Route Access Arrays

:::: {.group/codeblock .shiki .grid .shrink .grid-flow-col .overflow-hidden .mx-auto .page-width-wide:mx-0 .w-full .decoration-primary/6 .max-w-3xl .print:break-inside-avoid .page-width-wide:max-w-full .page-api-block:ml-0 color-scheme="light dark"}
::: {.flex .items-center .justify-start .gap-2 .text-sm .[grid-area:1/1]}
:::

[Copy]{.button-content .truncate}

``` {.relative .overflow-auto .border .border-tint-subtle .bg-tint-subtle .theme-bold-tint:bg-tint-base .theme-muted:bg-tint-base .p-2 .text-tint-strong .[grid-area:2/1] .contrast-more:border-tint .contrast-more:bg-tint-base .circular-corners:rounded-2xl .rounded-corners:rounded-xl .straight-corners:rounded-xs .depth-subtle:shadow-xs style="background-color:light-dark(inherit, inherit);--shiki-light-bg:inherit;--shiki-dark-bg:inherit;color:light-dark(inherit, inherit);--shiki-light:inherit;--shiki-dark:inherit"}
// /src/config/routes/path.ts

export const publicPaths = ['auth/login-1'];

export const anonymousPaths = ['/auth/login-1'];
```
::::

Explanation of Terms

1.  :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
    ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'1.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)"}
    :::
    ::::

    ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
    **Public Path** A path defined as a Public Path is accessible by
    both anonymous (not authenticated) and authenticated users. This
    means that any user, regardless of their authentication status, can
    access these routes.
    :::

2.  :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
    ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'2.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)"}
    :::
    ::::

    ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
    **Anonymous Path** A path defined as an Anonymous Path is accessible
    only if the user is anonymous (not authenticated). Authenticated
    users will be redirected if they try to access these routes.
    :::

3.  :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
    ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'3.';--font-family:inherit;font-size:min(1em, 24px)"}
    :::
    ::::

    ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
    **Authenticated Path** Any path not specified in the
    `publicPaths`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center
    .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm
    .text-[.875em] .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]} or
    `anonymousPaths`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center
    .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm
    .text-[.875em] .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]} arrays is
    considered an Authenticated Path. These paths are accessible only by
    authenticated users. Attempting to access these routes without being
    authenticated will result in a redirection to the login page or an
    access denied message.
    :::

**Examples**

Here's how you can configure different routes:

Middleware for Route Access Control
:::

In Jumbo, two middleware functions, `anonymousMiddleware`{.py-px .px-1.5
.min-w-6.5 .justify-center .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint
.bg-tint .rounded-sm .text-[.875em]

.px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset
.ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm .text-[.875em]
.leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}, are used to manage access to
routes. These middleware functions determine whether a user can continue
to the requested path or should be redirected based on their
authentication status. The logic for this can be found in
`/src/middleware.ts`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center
.items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm
.text-[.875em] .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}.

::: {.flex-1 .z-1 .justify-self-start .max-w-full .break-words .text-start .self-start .justify-start .leading-snug}
AuthMiddleware
:::

**Purpose**

Restricts access to authenticated (private) routes. Only users with a
valid session token should be able to access these routes.

**Behaviour**

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  Checks if a session token is present in the request cookies.
  :::

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  If the token is **missing**, the user is redirected to the login page
  (`/auth/login`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center .items-center
  .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm .text-[.875em]
  .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}).
  :::

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  If the token is **present**, the user is allowed to proceed.
  :::

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  Optionally, the token can be **verified** for authenticity. If
  verification fails, the user may be redirected to an alternate login
  route (`/auth/login-1`{.py-px .px-1.5 .min-w-6.5 .justify-center
  .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm
  .text-[.875em] .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}).
  :::

**Use Case**

Apply this middleware to pages like dashboards, profiles, or settings
that require user authentication.

###  {#anonymous-middleware .text-lg .@xs:text-xl .@lg:text-2xl .font-semibold .heading .flex .items-baseline .scroll-mt-(--content-scroll-margin) .text-start .self-start .justify-start .relative .group/hash .mx-auto .page-width-wide:mx-0 .w-full .decoration-primary/6 .max-w-3xl .print:break-inside-avoid .page-api-block:ml-0 .column-first-of-type:pt-0 .pt-[0.75em]}

::: {.flex-1 .z-1 .justify-self-start .max-w-full .break-words .text-start .self-start .justify-start .leading-snug}
Anonymous Middleware
:::

**Purpose**

Prevents authenticated users from accessing routes intended only for
anonymous users (e.g., login or registration pages).

**Behavoiur**

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  Checks if a session token is present in the request cookies.
  :::

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  If the token **exists**, the user is redirected to a default
  authenticated page (such as `/dashboards/analytical`{.py-px .px-1.5
  .min-w-6.5 .justify-center .items-center .ring-1 .ring-inset
  .ring-tint .bg-tint .rounded-sm .text-[.875em]
  .leading-[calc(max(1.20em,1.25rem))]}).
  :::

- :::: {.text-base .leading-normal .mr-1 .flex .min-h-lh .min-w-6 .items-center .justify-center .text-tint}
  ::: {.before:font-var .before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"}
  :::
  ::::

  ::: {.flex .min-w-0 .flex-1 .flex-col .space-y-2}
  If the token is **not present**, the user is allowed to proceed.
